Name: Joja Bundle Buyout
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
One project corresponds to one room, and that room is finished the moment the payment goes through. Buy a project on the Joja development form, and the matching bundle room is completed on the spot; the project itself is completed the next day. Any rewards you haven't claimed yet end up in the reward bag at the Community Center. The Bulletin Board and the Movie Theater are ordered by choosing "Community Projects" at Robin's shop.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Install SMAPI. 2. Extract the downloaded archive and place the JojaBundles folder into `Stardew Valley/Mods`. 3. Launch the game through SMAPI.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
1. Buy a Joja membership, then open the Community Development Form at JojaMart. 2. Select a project and pay the corresponding amount. The matching bundle room is completed immediately. 3. Any bundle rewards you haven't claimed yet stay in the reward bag in the Community Center's main hall. 4. For the parts Joja doesn't cover, go to Robin at the Carpenter's Shop and order the Bulletin Board repair or the Movie Theater construction.
- Vault → Vault - Boiler Room → Boiler Room (Minecarts) - Crafts Room → Crafts Room (Bridge) - Pantry → Pantry (Greenhouse) - Fish Tank → Fish Tank
